summary.plain: A battery of detectors around a lead target: a lead-glass wall for photons, tracking arms in the large Goliath magnet for charged particles, and counters measuring the multiplicity and energy of everything else.
summary.technical: WA98: Plastic Ball (655 modules) around a thin lead target; silicon drift and pad multiplicity detectors; two tracking spectrometer arms with scintillator-slat time-of-flight in the 1.6 Tm Goliath magnet; lead-glass photon detector array with charged-particle veto; photon multiplicity detector (21 m2, 21.5 m from the target); MIRAC and zero-degree calorimeters.

technology.quote: The WA98 experiment combined photon and hadron spectrometers with several other large acceptance detectors that allow for measuring various global variables on an event-by-event basis.
technology.value: Photon and hadron spectrometers (lead-glass photon array; tracking arms in the Goliath dipole) with large-acceptance global detectors
